items.name: Shroom and Gloom
items.desc: Gather and grow cards in Shroom & Gloom, a moody first-person, roguelike double-deckbuilder bursting with fungal foes and mountains of mega-combos!

items.name: Romestead
items.desc: Rome has fallen! Rebuild civilization in this action-adventure survival game for 1-8 players. Fight hordes of the walking dead, build settlements, restore the Roman gods... or kick back and farm with friends.

items.name: Slay the Spire 2
items.desc: The iconic roguelike deckbuilder returns. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, and discover relics of immense power in Slay the Spire 2!

items.name: CloverPit
items.desc: A rogue-lite slot machine nightmare. Gamble for your life in a never-ending debt simulator!

items.name: Alchemy Factory
items.desc: Start small, team up with friends, and automate production with conveyor belts, pipes, and magical devices. Stock your shop with potions, jewelry, and relics, complete commissions, and build an alchemy empire! Alchemy Factory 1.0 is out now with the Wagon Logistics System and revamped shopkeeping.

items.name: Leafy Corner
items.desc: Run a cute little plant shop in this cozy and relaxing game. Grow, sell, and care for a variety of real-life plants, help customers find their dream plants, complete orders, and customize your cozy shop just the way you like!

items.name: Voidtrain
items.sub: HypeTrain Digital · Open World Survival Craft, Co-op, Survival
items.desc: Become a crew member of an Interdimensional Express Train! Discover a new world full of mysterious creatures, enemies and places. Upgrade and customize your train, gather new materials and build better weapons. Play solo or online сo-op with up to 4 people.

items.name: Nientum - Op.ZERO
items.desc: A 2D action-adventure where the story unfolds by tuning the stage with music. A play by Aleph and Liora, who have lost their memories. A beautiful yet eerie stage, and the secret of the forgotten theater await. Your choices will determine the play's ending — and their fates.

items.name: Sandustry
items.sub: Lantto Games · Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
items.desc: Explore and mine fully destructible worlds. Automate increasingly complex production chains. Delve deep to uncover an ancient civilization’s powerful secrets and learn to love the sand in this factory game where every pixel is a valuable resource.

items.name: The Artisan of Glimmith
items.desc: The Artisan of Glimmith is a cozy, relaxing puzzle game about coloring stained glass and restoring the artworks of a kingdom above the clouds. Explore a world of handcrafted puzzles designed with intent, where simple rules lead to delightful surprises.

items.name: Outcast Tales
items.desc: A challenging post-apocalyptic roguelite turn-based RPG about the psychological stresses of adventuring with complete idiots. Lead a crew of flawed heroes against the consequences of their own terrible decisions. Can you keep your heroes together when everyone thinks they're in charge?

items.name: Checkmate: The Red General’s Last Move
items.desc: Checkmate is a turn-based Xiangqi roguelite where a lone red general carries a cannon into a 9×10 battlefield. Move to reload, fire risky snap shots, aim for precision, and use enemy pieces as firing screens. Each upgrade also strengthens the opposing army.

items.name: Mahjong Rush
items.desc: A single-player mahjong roguelike with an ink-wash art style. Make runs and sets from your tiles to score points — complete a winning hand and your score multiplies. Buy Flower cards, talismans and treasures to get stronger.. Never played mahjong? A step-by-step tutorial gets you started.

items.name: Operator: Observation
items.desc: Take on the role of Colin Nox, a security operator monitoring surveillance cameras for anomalies. What starts as a routine job quickly turns sinister as the anomalies grow more aggressive, invading the houses you watch, breaking into your home, and crawling into your mind.

items.name: Spook & Sell
items.sub: Crushed Olives Studios · Adventure, Casual, Strategy
items.desc: Stage the haunt. Sell the house. You’re the world’s most desperate real-estate agents — hide the ghosts, mop the ectoplasm, and keep buyers calm in this chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics party game before the haunting meter tips over.
